newsitem.title: USA: Air Force halts Gulf training flights.
newsitem.headline: Air Force halts Gulf training flights.

text.p: The Air Force on Monday expanded its suspension of flight training operations off the East Coast to include the Gulf of Mexico following more reports of close proximity incidents between civilian planes and military jets.

The Pentagon made the announcement as CNN reported two more incidents on Friday in which an F-16 fighter jet got closer than 5 miles to a Northwest Airlines Airbus over Texas and two other F-16s came within 3.5 miles of an American Airlines plane over New Mexico.
